name: std-migration-job
description: std-migration-job — one import run of external data into the host system, modeled as a persistent MigrationJob row with a lifecycle state machine: idle → fetching → mapping → reviewing → committing → done | failed. All source access goes through the migration service (call-service "migration" listDocuments / fetchDocument / commit) — the atom never talks to a source directly, and the host-injected service handler resolves credentials from the connectionRef knob (a reference, never the secret). Staging/mapping is host work (deterministic pipeline or agent): the atom fetches, the host stages and emits MIGRATION_STAGED with stats and, optionally, the staged units/skipped/validationErrors rows themselves — when the rows are supplied, reviewing renders an ImportPreviewTree so the user can see what will commit before approving. The user approves (MIGRATION_APPROVED) and only then does commit run. Terminal runs persist the job row for provenance. Rebind the entity to a host-owned job entity via linkedEntity; target, connectionRef and reviewSlot are config knobs.

fields.description: ImportSource descriptor of the run (kind + options), supplied by the host.
fields.name: source

fields.description: Client-side file metadata for upload sources (name/size/type/lastModified).
fields.name: files

fields.description: Name of the host entity this import writes into.
fields.name: target

fields.description: Document metadata listed from the source — migration.listDocuments service result, never destructured by the atom.
fields.name: documents

fields.description: Most recently fetched document content — migration.fetchDocument service result, never destructured by the atom.
fields.name: document

fields.description: Staged/committed/failed/skipped counts — merged from host staging and migration.commit service results, never destructured by the atom.
fields.name: stats

fields.description: Staged ImportUnits ready for review (ref/targetEntity/fields/parentRef), when the host stages the full rows rather than aggregate stats only.
fields.name: units
fields.synonyms: staged units, preview rows, import rows, staged rows

fields.description: Source elements skipped during staging with a reason each, when the host stages the full rows rather than aggregate stats only.
fields.name: skipped
fields.synonyms: skipped rows, skipped elements, staging skips

fields.description: Validation errors surfaced during staging, when the host stages the full rows rather than aggregate stats only.
fields.name: validationErrors
fields.synonyms: staging errors, validation issues, import errors

fields.description: Failure detail when status is failed.
fields.name: error

connectionRef.description: Secret-store / environment KEY holding the source credentials. The reference is stored; the secret itself never enters config, traces, or snapshots — the migration service resolves it at run time. (Typed `secret` — the config-field type that marks a credential reference; UI password-renders it and traces mask it.)
connectionRef.label: Connection reference
connectionRef.synonyms: credential key, connection string reference, secret name

reviewSlot.description: UI slot the staged-import review renders into when the host stages the full units/skipped rows (not stats-only). Defaults to the modal overlay so a host that never places this trait on a page — or that only ever sends {stats} — stays effectively headless; the rendered tree's confirm/cancel wire to the atom's own MIGRATION_APPROVED/MIGRATION_DISCARDED events.
reviewSlot.label: Review slot
reviewSlot.synonyms: preview slot, review outlet, staging modal, import review slot

target.description: Name of the host entity this import writes into (e.g. the organism's own entity). The migration service derives the full target descriptor from the running app's schema.
target.label: Target entity

emits.description: migration.listDocuments service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor
migration.fetchDocument service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor
migration.commit service result — committed count plus per-unit failures
migration service call failure signal — lands the run in failed, never a silent swallow
Source documents are listed and the run is ready for staging (deterministic pipeline or agent)
emits.synonyms: import fetched, source listed, documents ready

emits.description: A single fetched document's content, for the host staging layer to map into target units

Staging is complete; the preview is ready for the approval gate. units/skipped/validationErrors forward the full staged rows when the host staged them, for a review-before-commit UI; stats-only hosts leave them empty.
emits.synonyms: preview ready, staging complete, review import

emits.description: The commit drained through the host sink; stats carry committed and per-unit failed counts
emits.synonyms: import done, migration complete, data imported

emits.description: The run failed; error carries the service-reported detail and the terminal job row was persisted

events.description: Starts an import run. source is the ImportSource descriptor; files carries client file metadata for upload sources. Also reached via a sibling std-import's IMPORT_REQUESTED.
events.name: Migration Start
events.synonyms: start import, run migration, import data

events.description: migration.listDocuments service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor
events.name: Documents Listed

events.description: Source documents are listed and the run is ready for staging (deterministic pipeline or agent)
events.name: Migration Fetched
events.synonyms: import fetched, source listed, documents ready

events.description: A single fetched document's content, for the host staging layer to map into target units
events.name: Migration Document

events.description: migration service call failure signal — lands the run in failed, never a silent swallow
events.name: Migration Call Failed

events.description: Fetch one document's full content from the source during staging
events.name: Fetch Document

events.description: migration.fetchDocument service result, flattened onto the payload by the call-service effect executor
events.name: Document Fetched

events.description: Host staging finished — units are staged and validated; stats summarize staged/skipped counts for the preview. units/skipped/validationErrors optionally carry the full staged rows (server ImportPreview shape) so reviewing can render an ImportPreviewTree instead of staying headless.
events.name: Migration Staged

events.description: The run was discarded before commit
events.name: Migration Discarded

events.description: The user approved the preview; units are the staged ImportUnits to commit through the host sink. Optional — the ImportPreviewTree's onConfirm fires with no payload, so commit falls back to the units already staged on the entity via MIGRATION_STAGED.
events.name: Migration Approved

events.description: The user sent the preview back for more staging
events.name: Migration Rejected

events.description: Staging is complete; the preview is ready for the approval gate. units/skipped/validationErrors forward the full staged rows when the host staged them, for a review-before-commit UI; stats-only hosts leave them empty.
events.name: Migration Review Ready
events.synonyms: preview ready, staging complete, review import

events.description: migration.commit service result — committed count plus per-unit failures
events.name: Committed

events.description: Returns the job to idle from a terminal state
events.name: Reset

events.description: The commit drained through the host sink; stats carry committed and per-unit failed counts
events.name: Migration Completed
events.synonyms: import done, migration complete, data imported

events.description: Re-runs the fetch after a failure, with the same source
events.name: Migration Retry

events.description: The run failed; error carries the service-reported detail and the terminal job row was persisted
events.name: Migration Failed
